newsitem.title: USA: Washington Post page one - Sept 16.
newsitem.headline: Washington Post page one - Sept 16.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Sept. 16:

WASHINGTON - Kuwait temporarily withheld permission for the United States to dispatch several thousand U.S. troops to the Gulf in a snafu blamed on the Pentagon's premature announcement of the troop movements.
WASHINGTON - America Online Inc. is launching a major campaign costing hundreds of millions of dollars to woo new computer users.

WASHINGTON - With few exceptions, the ranking Democrats on key House committees all come from the liberal wing of the Democratic party and many have agendas that reach well beyond the modest plans outlined by President Clinton.
WASHINGTON - House Minority Leader Richard Gephardt insists his party has learned the lessons of defeat and would curb its liberal instincts if Democrats are restored to power in November.
TORONTO - Canada was in mourning after watching the national hockey team lose to a U.S. team.
